about.text:
{name} {version}

Project page: {url}
License: {license}

Config: {config}
Data: {data}
det.tokens: Known token formats (GitLab, GitHub, AWS, JWT …)
det.tracking: Tracking in links (utm_*, click ids, Safe Links …) – removed
img.copied: Redacted image copied to the clipboard ({n} area(s)).
img.detected: {n} area(s) found: {faces} face(s), {nudity} nudity, {text} text area(s), {codes} code(s). Check the result – add missing areas by hand.
img.detecting: Detecting faces, nudity, text and codes …
img.effect_warning: Pixelated or blurred TEXT can often be reconstructed (e.g. with Unredacter). For text and codes only "black" is safe; mosaic is meant for faces.
img.hint: Drag with the mouse to add an area. Move areas, resize them at the lower right corner, Del deletes. Ctrl+mouse wheel zooms. Right click: effect.
img.no_plugin: The plugin ({helper}) was not found, so nothing is detected automatically. Draw the areas by hand, or install the plugin (Settings › NER plugin).
img.plugin_old: The installed plugin has no image functions yet. Install the plugin of this version.
img.set_text: Detect sensitive text (OCR + the detectors: IP, e-mail, secrets, custom terms …)
img.set_watch: Watcher: offer "Redact image" when an image is copied
img.settings_intro: Automatic detection in images needs the plugin (Settings › NER plugin); it runs locally. Areas can always be drawn by hand in the Image tab.
job.image_detect: image: detect faces, nudity, text, codes
lists.allow_domains_help: Public domains (and their sub-domains) that stay unchanged, e.g. github.com. One per line.
lists.allow_ip_ranges_help: Networks in CIDR notation that stay unchanged, e.g. 8.8.8.0/24. One per line.
lists.allow_terms_help: Exact values that are never replaced. One per line.
lists.extra_tlds_help: Additional top-level domains to detect (e.g. internal suffixes like "lab"). One per line.
lists.generic_labels_extra_help: Parts of host names and infrastructure names (namespaces, releases …) that identify nothing and stay as they are, e.g. "k8s", "worker" or a product name. One per line.
lists.known_domains_help: Your own/customer domains. They and all sub-domains are always detected, independent of heuristics. One per line.
lists.terms_help: Terms that are always replaced (customer names, internal code names …). Type decides how the replacement is generated; a fixed replacement is used verbatim. Single words with a fixed replacement are also used inside domains ("Acme" → acme.de).
lists.tracking_params_help: Additional URL parameters that are removed from links (the built-in list covers utm_*, fbclid, gclid, mc_eid, _hsenc, mkt_tok, share ids of YouTube/Spotify/X/TikTok/LinkedIn … and redirect wrappers such as Outlook Safe Links). One per line, e.g. "campaign_id".
llm.api_key_optional: optional – only if the endpoint requires one
llm.detect: Use the LLM as additional detector for names/companies (sends the ORIGINAL text to the endpoint)
llm.note: Optional: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM, Ollama, LiteLLM, Open WebUI …) for screenshot → text, checking results and detecting names. Enter the URL, test, pick the model.
llm.test_hint: Loads the model list from the endpoint. "/v1" is added automatically if missing.

log.image_detect: Image analysed: {faces} face(s), {nudity} nudity area(s), {text} sensitive text area(s) in {lines} line(s), {codes} code(s)

ner.not_found: NER helper "{helper}" not found – see Settings › NER plugin for download and setup
ner.setup_source:
Running from source: install the plugin with
   pip install -r requirements-ner.txt
in the same Python environment. It is then used automatically (folder: {folder}). Afterwards tick "Enable NER" and click "Test".
ner.setup_steps:
The plugin finds names of people and companies that have no fixed format (NER), and faces, text and QR codes/barcodes in images (Image tab). It is a separate program so that the main program stays small; everything runs locally.

It is part of every release package:
   • Windows MSI / ZIP: {win}
   • Linux tar.gz: {linux} next to the program
It contains spaCy and the German and English models; nothing else is downloaded.

1. If the status above says "not found": install the MSI with the NER feature, or unpack the complete ZIP / tar.gz, so that the helper lies in this folder (or its subfolder "ner"):
   {folder}
2. Tick "Enable NER", click "Test" and save with OK.
The helper can also lie somewhere else – then select it under "Helper program".
ner.status_missing: Status: helper not found – see steps below

project.passphrase_hint: Mappings (including original values and secrets) are stored on disk. On Windows the file is always encrypted with your Windows account (DPAPI). A passphrase adds encryption that also protects against other programs running under your account (AES-256-GCM, scrypt) – you then have to enter it when opening the project.
project.protection_tip.dpapi: The mapping file is encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The key is protected by Windows (DPAPI) and can only be used by your Windows account – no passphrase needed. Other users, copies of the disk or backups cannot read it.
project.protection_tip.none: The mapping file (original values, secrets) is stored as readable JSON, protected only by the file permissions of your user account. Set a passphrase for this project to encrypt it.
project.protection_tip.passphrase: The mapping file is encrypted with AES-256-GCM; the key comes from the project passphrase (scrypt).
